comment: Just the most boring lectures I've ever experienced.
Exam that's worth 35 percent of the overall grade, and he went missing the week before the exam. Just a bad experience overall.
Good professor that is enthusiastic and loves to teach. Just do the practice questions he posts and the readings but heavily focus on class and you should get an A.

It breaks my heart to say because he seems like such a sweet guy but he was one of the worst professors I have had. Classes were a jumbled and confusing mess, and the tests were the only time I realized what we were supposed to be learning all along. His tests were hard and confusing and his "trick questions" are meant to lead to wrong answers.

There is no teacher like Amit Eynan. He is constantly making jokes and is sometimes hard to understand. If you put in mild effort, an A is definitely attainable. There are 3 exams, and only 3 short homework assignments throughout the semester. I did not go to every class, but definitely make sure you look at his study guides and practice exams.

DONT. No good options for OM but this was bad. He's a REALLY nice/funny guy but this class made no sense at all. Lost from day 1 to the final. Going to class felt like a waste of time bc I had no idea what was happening. Tests were hard bc material made no sense from class. Get a good/smart group for the cases. Have to show work on multiple choice.

Would definitely recommend Dr. Eynan for OM.  While his class at times can be a little boring, his wicked sense of humor helps pass the time. Very passionate and always willing to help (also doesn't hurt that he allows as many corrections as needed for the cases).

This guy is genuine and very smart. A bit hard to understand but the text book he created makes up for his accent. Readings are short, homework is just test practice and can be done as studying before the test. No final exam.
Hes a nice guy. Very hard to understand. I don't know anyone who got an A. No one got worse than a C

I couldn't understand a word he said due to his accent. His class is incredibly boring...sure the material isn't thrilling, but he could do a much better job teaching it. A large portion of the grade is participation and there are hardly any opportunities to participate.
"it's good to see you all."  says this before EVERY class (we counted).  funny unintentionally, he started dancing to a girl's cell phone ring once.  no final, easy tests.  take him.
he is so adorable... yeah class is boring but his quirky comments and dumb jokes pass the time pretty well. and you cant beat a class with easy tests and no final.

Wow. Bring a magazine or something for during class. You do need to take the few notes he does give you, which are in the packet half-filled out. Tests are easy if you just do the practice problems. I think he got his lesson plans straight out of 1983 and never switched. Has no concept of English; can be funny because he speaks with a funny accent.

Really easy tests.  Class is boring, but he can't help that.  English not his first language, but was easy to understand.  Need to attend class every day though, as tests are taken DIRECTLY from notes and homework.

Not sure if he actually understands english. Lanuage barrier caused many problems. Course was orginally designed in 80's and has not been updated since. Video's and handouts are out of date. Gives no reason for grades, mainly because he can not explain his own reasoning.
